items.title: Monad proposes wallet upgrade that could survive lost keys and quantum attacks
items.summary: The Ethereum-compatible blockchain wants users to be able to replace the keys controlling an account without changing its address, opening the door to passkeys, recovery tools and post-quantum security.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $80,000, solana jumps 8% but rally now runs into overbought warning
items.summary: BTC is up more than 25% on the week after Treasury’s bond-buyback expansion sparked a rally, while Solana led majors Tuesday as validators vote on proposals to slow new SOL creation and raise daily burns.

items.title: Ray Dalio says investors should own ‘a bit of Bitcoin’ as U.S. debt risks rise
items.summary: The Bridgewater founder says recent Treasury-market stress fits his long-running debt-crisis framework, though he still prefers gold as the bigger hedge.

items.title: ECB defends digital euro privacy as CBDCs face global scrutiny
items.summary: Piero Cipollone said the Eurosystem would not identify digital euro users as central bank digital currencies face privacy concerns worldwide.

items.title: Fed study finds crypto investors driven by beliefs, easily swayed by returns
items.summary: A Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland study finds crypto investors hold sharply different views on returns and risk, while information about Bitcoin’s past gains can increase both desired allocations and actual crypto purchases.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs draw a seventh straight day of inflows as the rally holds above $80,000
items.summary: Spot bitcoin funds took in $337.56 million on Aug. 24, extending an unbroken run of inflows that has now put real money behind a rally that started with a short squeeze.

items.title: Treasury’s bond buyback plan fights the market and heightens the danger, billionaire Druckenmiller says
items.summary: The billionaire investor argues the intervention removes a vital check on government borrowing and fiscal accountability while markets remain the better judge of prices.

items.title: Crypto rally spills into dog and cat memecoins as smaller tokens double in a week
items.summary: Robinhood Chain-based Cash Cat jumped more than 50% in a day, while several smaller animal-themed tokens have gained between 50% and 130% over the past week.

items.title: Bitcoin traders place $2.9 million bet on a rapid price jump above $82,000
items.summary: Traders are spending millions to position for further Bitcoin upside after its staggering rally to $80,000, though demand for downside protection remains firm, according to Laevitas.

items.title: Bitcoin hits $80,000 for the first time since May as crypto recovery accelerates
items.summary: BTC has now surged 38% following its June plunge as shifting U.S. Treasury policy helped bring buyers back to crypto, rejuvenating ETF demand.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: US targets Iran’s crypto sector, cites over $100M in oil-linked payments
items.summary: The US Treasury expanded sanctions to Iran’s digital asset sector, alleging a UAE-based broker processed over $100 million in crypto for oil sales.

items.title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
items.summary: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.

items.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
items.summary: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.

items.title: Bitcoin nears $80,000, but analysts say the next pullback will be key
items.summary: Analysts say consolidation could strengthen bitcoin’s rally, while thin trading above $80,000 may set up sharper price moves.

items.title: Crypto political group details list of U.S. congressional allies its backing this year
items.summary: Stand With Crypto, a member group that rates the crypto friendliness of politicians, is supporting 32 U.S. House incumbents, with more endorsements coming.

items.title: Coinbase debuts tokenized stocks on Base network, joining race to bring equities on blockchain
items.summary: The crypto exchange is starting with tokenized versions of Apple, Nvidia, Meta and Alphabet, issued under its new Abu Dhabi framework.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine buys $81 million of ETH in largest weekly haul since early July
items.summary: The treasury firm stepped up its ETH buying as Tom Lee said the crypto’s 30% weekly rally could signal a larger move ahead.

items.title: New Solana vote could ramp daily SOL burns to $800,000 and slow new token creation
items.summary: Two of the three proposals would reduce SOL supply growth by speeding up Solana’s inflation decline and raising daily fee burns from about 650 SOL to as much as 9,000 SOL.

items.title: Strategy raises $2 billion through MSTR sales and creates new USD Cash pool
items.summary: The company sold 18.26 million MSTR shares, increased its USD Reserve to $5.1 billion and repurchased another $136.4 million of STRC.
